basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old gamer based in Seattle, working as a software developer. I have a deep passion for gaming, especially on platforms like Stadia and PlayStation. Besides gaming, I enjoy listening to history podcasts like Dan Carlin's Hardcore History during my commute. I'm single and often online during evenings and weekends. When I'm not gaming, I like exploring new tech gadgets and cooking new recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in software development with a degree in Computer Science. I've been a gamer since childhood, and I've kept up with the latest trends and technologies in the gaming world through self-study and participating in online communities.
